attributes.background: Schools are being closed due to weather. Winter, now summer. They need to be invested in and all need to be upgraded to have a good heating/air conditioning system in place so we can keep our young people and teachers comfortable whilst learning.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
